summary: Requesting that Scarborough Community Council consider this item as new business and support the following request: Scarborough Community Council direct Transportation Services staff to: 1. Request the Director, Transportation Services, Scarborough District to report back to the May 2, 2018 meeting of Scarborough Community Council on the reduction of the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on all local roads around schools within the confines of the Scarborough Community Council area, excluding those roads that bound more than one community council area.
